newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firmer, upswing seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firmer, upswing seen.

text.p: Austrian shares ended the week on a buoyant note as the March future contract expired and traders predicted further upside next week, as long as U.S. rate fears and EMU uncertainty did not weigh on sentiment.
"The consolidation period seems to have ended," said one trader.
Dealers forecast the index would head back up towards the 1,245/1,250-point mark in the next two weeks.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips climbed 7.10 points or 0.59 percent to 1,216.60. Among its constituents 13 shares rose, six fell and two were unchanged.
The session's top gainer was microchip maker AMS, adding 5.31 percent to 1,091 schillings.
Luxury hosiery maker Wolford led the decliners, shedding 3.14 percent to 390 schillings.
The March ATX future gained four points on its expiry to close at 1,211 points. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 257
